evidence: Quick Game starts with one yard; a second can be built through the planet queue
Combined construction rate equals the sum of two separate lanes
Native engine rejects unit designs in yard queues and accepts them in planet queues
Catalog exposes native design types, hulls, component families/levels and all researched facility versions
Upgrade Facilities moves queued builds to latest researched versions while preserving count and paid resources
Installed facilities upgrade through paid construction, with no facility-slot increase; save/load retains yards
